services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: National Cambodian Heritage Museum and Memorial provides guided tours of all exhibitions, dialogues with visitors, and genocide workshops and symposiums. Our long-term goal is to bring social justice and healing to the genocide survivors by expanding awareness and education about Cambodia's history, and work toward rebuilding the Cambodian community that were devastated by that era. In just 3 years, 8 months and 20 days, more than two million Cambodians died from ruthless slaughter, starvation and disease. This exhibition honors not only those who died, but also those who survived to keep their memory
